hooks.name: Attribution reminder on package.json save
hooks.description: Reminds the agent to add every new dependency to docs/ATTRIBUTION.md with licence and link (Kiroween disclosure rule).

action.prompt: package.json was saved. Run `bash scripts/hooks/deps-check.sh`. For every dependency it reports as missing, add a row to docs/ATTRIBUTION.md with the component, what it is used for, its licence (read it from node_modules/<name>/package.json) and a link. Run the script again until it prints ok. Do not add dependencies that nobody asked for.
